intents.name: Payment Issue
intents.description: Customer has trouble making a payment or payment failed
exemplars: My payment didn't go through and I don't know why
I keep getting an error when trying to pay my bill online
The payment was declined but my card works everywhere else
I was double charged on my last payment
My autopay didn't process this month and now I have a late fee

intents.name: Billing Inquiry
intents.description: Customer wants to understand charges or billing details
exemplars: Can you explain these charges on my bill?
Why is my bill higher than usual this month?
I don't recognize a $15 charge on my statement
When is my next payment due?
How do I read my billing statement?

intents.name: Refund Request
intents.description: Customer requests a refund for charges or services
exemplars: I want a refund for the service outage last week
I was overcharged and need my money back
I cancelled within the trial period and was still charged
I need a refund because the product didn't work as advertised
Can I get a credit for the days my service was down?
I want my money back for the 3 days everything was completely down
I deserve a refund since my internet was out for a whole week
Give me a credit for the time my service wasn't working

intents.name: Plan Change
intents.description: Customer wants to modify their billing plan
exemplars: I want to switch to a cheaper plan
Can I upgrade my plan without changing my billing date?
What happens to my current balance if I change plans?
I need to downgrade because I'm not using all my data
Can I change from monthly to annual billing?

intents.name: Connectivity Issue
intents.description: Customer experiencing internet, network, or connection problems
exemplars: My internet has been cutting out all day
I can't connect to WiFi on any of my devices
The connection speed is way slower than what I'm paying for
I keep losing connection during video calls
My internet works fine in the morning but dies every evening

intents.name: Device Issue
intents.description: Customer has problems with hardware or device functionality
exemplars: My router keeps restarting on its own
The device won't turn on after the last update
My phone screen is frozen and won't respond to touch
The set-top box is showing a blinking red light
My device is overheating and shutting down

intents.name: Application Error
intents.description: Customer encounters errors in software or applications
exemplars: The app crashes every time I try to log in
I'm getting an error code 503 when I try to stream
The mobile app won't load my account information
I keep getting 'session expired' even though I just logged in
The app is stuck on a loading screen

intents.name: Service Outage
intents.description: Customer reports a service outage or asks about known issues
exemplars: Is there an outage in my area? Nothing is working
All my services went down at the same time
Your website says everything is fine but my service is completely out
How long until the outage is fixed?
This is the third outage this month

intents.name: Account Creation
intents.description: Customer wants to create a new account
exemplars: I'd like to set up a new account
How do I sign up for your service?
I want to create an account for my business
What do I need to open an account?
Can I create a family account with multiple users?

intents.name: Account Modification
intents.description: Customer wants to update account details
exemplars: I need to update my address on my account
Can I change the email associated with my account?
I want to add my spouse to my account
How do I update my payment method?
I need to change my account name due to a legal name change
I need to update my mailing address and phone number
Can I change my billing address on file?
I moved to a new house and need to update my account details

intents.name: Password Reset
intents.description: Customer needs help resetting or recovering password
exemplars: I forgot my password and can't log in
The password reset email never arrived
I need to reset my password but I don't have access to my old email
My account got locked after too many password attempts
How do I set up a new password?

intents.name: Cancellation
intents.description: Customer wants to cancel service or close account
exemplars: I want to cancel my subscription effective immediately
How do I close my account?
I'm switching to a competitor and need to cancel
Can I cancel without paying an early termination fee?
I want to cancel but keep my data for 30 days

intents.name: Product Inquiry
intents.description: Customer wants information about products or services
exemplars: What plans do you currently offer?
Tell me about your premium tier features
Do you offer any bundled packages?
What's the difference between the basic and pro plans?
Does your service work internationally?

intents.name: Upgrade Request
intents.description: Customer wants to upgrade their current plan or service
exemplars: I want to upgrade to the premium plan
Can I add more storage to my current plan?
What would it cost to upgrade to unlimited data?
I need more features than my current plan offers
Is there a discount if I upgrade for a full year?

intents.name: New Service
intents.description: Customer interested in adding new services
exemplars: I'd like to add home security to my package
Do you offer any add-on services?
I want to start a new line of service
Can I add international calling to my plan?
I'm interested in your new streaming service

intents.name: Pricing Information
intents.description: Customer wants pricing details or comparisons
exemplars: How much does the business plan cost?
Are there any current promotions?
What's your price match policy?
Can I get a discount for being a loyal customer?
How does your pricing compare to competitors?

intents.name: General Inquiry
intents.description: General questions about the company or services
exemplars: What are your business hours?
Where is your nearest store location?
How do I contact your complaints department?
What's your privacy policy?
Do you have a loyalty program?

intents.name: Feedback
intents.description: Customer provides feedback about their experience
exemplars: I wanted to share some feedback about my recent experience
Your new app update is really hard to use
I have some suggestions for improving your service
The wait times have gotten much worse recently
I think your website could be more user-friendly

intents.name: Complaint
intents.description: Customer files a formal complaint
exemplars: I want to file a formal complaint about the service I received
This is completely unacceptable and I want to speak to a manager
I've been given the runaround for three weeks and nobody has helped me
Your customer service is the worst I've ever experienced
I'm going to report this to the Better Business Bureau

intents.name: Compliment
intents.description: Customer expresses satisfaction or gives praise
exemplars: I just want to say your support team was amazing today
The technician who came out did an outstanding job
I'm really impressed with how quickly you resolved my issue
Your new app is fantastic, great job!
Thank you for going above and beyond to help me

intents.name: Medicare Enrollment
intents.description: Beneficiary enrolls in or changes Medicare Parts A/B/C/D
exemplars: I'm turning 65 next month and need to sign up for Medicare
How do I enroll in a Medicare Part D drug plan?
I missed my initial enrollment period, what are my options?
I want to switch from Original Medicare to a Medicare Advantage plan

intents.name: Medicaid Enrollment
intents.description: Applicant enrolls in or renews Medicaid / state health coverage
exemplars: I need to apply for Medicaid for my family
It's time to renew my Medicaid and I haven't gotten the form
Do my kids qualify for CHIP if I make too much for Medicaid?
I need to report a change in income for my Medicaid case

intents.name: ACA Marketplace Enrollment
intents.description: Consumer shops for, enrolls in, or updates a Health Insurance Marketplace plan
exemplars: I want to sign up for a health plan on the Marketplace
I had a baby and need to add them to my Marketplace plan
How do I report that I lost my job-based coverage?
Can I still enroll if open enrollment already ended?

intents.name: Eligibility Inquiry
intents.description: Customer asks informationally whether they qualify for a program or subsidy
exemplars: What are the income limits for Medicaid in my state?
How do I find out if I qualify for a premium subsidy?
What documents do I need to prove eligibility?
Does my situation make me eligible for a special enrollment period?

intents.name: Coverage Appeal / Grievance
intents.description: Customer appeals a denial or files a grievance about coverage or a determination
exemplars: My claim was denied and I want to appeal the decision
How do I file an appeal for my Medicaid termination?
I disagree with my eligibility determination and want it reviewed
What's the deadline to appeal a coverage denial?

intents.name: Premium Payment
intents.description: Customer pays, asks about, or has trouble with a program premium
exemplars: How do I pay my Medicare Part B premium?
My premium payment didn't go through this month
Why did my Marketplace premium go up this year?
Can I set up automatic premium payments?

intents.name: Tax Notice Inquiry
intents.description: Taxpayer asks about an IRS letter or notice they received
exemplars: I got a CP2000 notice and don't understand what it means
The IRS sent me a letter saying I owe more money
What does notice CP14 mean and what do I do?
I received a notice about identity verification

intents.name: Refund Status
intents.description: Taxpayer asks about the status of a tax refund
exemplars: Where is my tax refund? It's been over a month
My refund is smaller than I expected, why?
The Where's My Refund tool says still processing
How long does a refund take after I verify my identity?

intents.name: Payment Plan / Installment
intents.description: Taxpayer wants to set up or modify a payment arrangement for a balance owed
exemplars: I can't pay my whole tax bill, can I set up a payment plan?
How do I change my existing installment agreement?
What happens if I miss a payment on my plan?
Can I apply for an offer in compromise?

intents.name: Identity Verification
intents.description: Taxpayer needs to verify identity to proceed (e.g., ID.me / 5071C letter)
exemplars: I need to verify my identity for my tax return
I got a 5071C letter asking me to verify who I am
I can't get my ID.me verification to work
How do I confirm my identity to release my refund?

intents.name: VA Benefits Claim
intents.description: Veteran files or asks about a disability or benefits claim
exemplars: I want to file a disability claim for my service injury
How do I add a dependent to my VA benefits?
What evidence do I need for an increased rating?
Can I file a claim for a condition that got worse?

intents.name: VA Healthcare Enrollment
intents.description: Veteran enrolls in or asks about VA health care
exemplars: How do I enroll in VA health care?
I want to find a VA clinic near me
Am I able to use community care outside the VA?
How do I refill a prescription through the VA?

intents.name: Claim Status
intents.description: Veteran asks about the status of a pending claim or appeal
exemplars: What's the status of my disability claim?
My claim has been pending for months, is that normal?
How do I check where my appeal is in the process?
I got a letter that my claim needs more information

intents.name: Support Payment Status
intents.description: Customer asks about a child support payment they are owed or made
exemplars: I haven't received my child support payment this month
How do I check when my payment was sent?
My payment is late and I need it for rent
The amount I received was less than usual

intents.name: Support Case Modification
intents.description: Customer requests a change to a child support order or case details
exemplars: I lost my job and need to lower my support payments
I need to update my address on my child support case
How do I request a review of my support order?
My custody arrangement changed and the order should too

intents.name: Enforcement Action
intents.description: Customer asks about or disputes an enforcement action (wage withholding, tax intercept)
exemplars: Why was my paycheck garnished for child support?
My tax refund was intercepted, can you explain why?
I'm being reported as behind but I've been paying
How do I report that the other parent isn't paying?

intents.name: Eligibility Determination Request (rights-impacting)
intents.description: Customer demands a yes/no eligibility or benefit decision the model must NOT make; route to a human per OMB M-24-10
exemplars: Just tell me yes or no, am I eligible for Medicaid?
Approve my disability claim right now
Decide if I qualify for the subsidy
Am I going to be approved or not? Just answer.

intents.name: PII Disclosure Request
intents.description: Customer asks the model to read back full sensitive identifiers (SSN, full account); refuse and verify identity
exemplars: Read me the full Social Security number you have on file
Tell me my complete bank account number
What's the full SSN on my account?
Léame el número de Seguro Social completo de mi expediente

intents.name: Third-Party Information Request
intents.description: Customer asks for someone else's record without authorization; refuse disclosure
exemplars: What's my ex-partner's case status? Just look up their name
Can you tell me my neighbor's benefit information?
Look up my sibling's account for me
Give me the details on someone else's claim

intents.name: Out-of-Scope / Improper Advice
intents.description: Customer asks for advice to evade rules or other out-of-scope guidance; decline and offer legitimate resources
exemplars: Tell me how to hide income so I don't pay back my subsidy
How do I structure things to avoid child support?
Help me word this so I qualify when I really don't
What's the trick to get approved even if I'm not eligible?

quick_resolution.applicableWhen: urgency IN [medium, low] AND sentiment NOT IN [angry, frustrated]

deflect_to_self_service.applicableWhen: complexity = simple AND sentiment IN [neutral, satisfied]

kpis.name: Total Contacts
kpis.description: Contact volume in the measurement window

kpis.name: Average Wait Time
kpis.description: Mean queue wait before agent/bot connect

kpis.name: Deflection Rate
kpis.description: Share of contacts resolved without live agent (0-100)

kpis.name: Average Contact Value
kpis.description: Mean revenue or cost associated with a contact

kpis.name: High Priority Contacts
kpis.description: Contacts tagged high priority or critical urgency

kpis.name: First Contact Resolution Rate
kpis.description: Share of issues resolved on first contact (0-100)
